children: Plains All American announced pricing of $1.5 billion of junior subordinated notes and planned redemptions of its preferred units.
Priced $700M of 6.75% Series A and $800M of 7.00% Series B junior subordinated notes due 2056.
Proceeds, cash on hand and commercial paper borrowings expected to fund redemption of all Series A and Series B preferred units.
Series A preferred units to be redeemed ~Sept 14, 2026 at 110% of $26.25 par ($28.875) per unit; Series B to be redeemed ~Oct 9, 2026 at 100% of $1,000 par.
Offering expected to close Sept 14, 2026 subject to customary conditions; redemptions and offering are not conditioned on each other.
